entries.title: Viewer with component and screen cards
entries.detail: Preview kit (tokens.css, bundle.css, icons, phone/tablet/desktop frames), viewer with search, foundations, primitives, marketplace components and customer, Seller and Office screens, documents and email.

entries.title: Buttons use white labels
entries.detail: Controls use primary #CD4B0E (white label 4.56:1, hover #B8420B 5.7:1). The logo orange #F97316 stays for the logo, illustrations and large decorative shapes.

entries.title: Design system created
entries.detail: tokens.json as single source; generated CSS for web, Office and Seller; Expo theme and Tailwind read the same tokens; ink-on-orange rule; contrast gate; 21 component specs.
